Biome Randomizer.name: Biome Randomizer

Biome Randomizer.description: A Fully Functional Dimension-Manipulating device. Changes the Current Biome Regardless of Natural Spawnrate. *(Except for glitched.) Has a 1/5000 chance to spawn Cyberspace.

Biome Selector.name: Biome Selector

Biome Selector.description: A device engineered with [Cyber City]'s advanced technology, it reads the data stored in the Biome Data Drive and recreates the biome in the space around the device.

Coin.name: Coin

Heavenly Potion.name: Heavenly Potion

Achievement, or by brewing it in Stella's Cauldron. The Heavenly Potion can also be bought from the Jester for 1000P. Oblivion Potion.name: Oblivion Potion
Oblivion Potion.how_to_get: The Oblivion Potion is obtainable from the traveling merchant, Jester, who has a spawn rate of 1 in 10 (10%) every 15-45 minutes. The player is able to purchase an Oblivion Potion from Jester for 5 Void Coins, and from Fischl for 3,500,000 Coins or 70,000 Dark Points. You can also obtain this potion via the 20, 30, 50 and 100 million roll achievements which give one, two, five and ten of them respectfully. The Update Packages, which refresh every major update, provide Potion Chests which have a chance of obtaining an Oblivion Potion. During the Winter 2025 event, it was possible to have rolled the Oblivion Potion from Potion Gift Boxes, with a 0.09% chance from the Normal Potion Gift Box, a 0.42% chance from the Rare Potion Gift Box, and a 2.82% chance from the Mega Potion Gift Box.
Oblivion Potion.description: Gives you [Oblivion] status [Oblivion]: +600,000 Luck for Next 1 Roll Also allows you to obtain [????????] with chance of 1 in 2,000 And [Memory] with chance of 1 in 100

Potion of Bound.description: A potion that is so Powerful it got BOUNDED. Gives you [Binding]:+50,000 Luck for Next 1 Roll

This makes it a highly valuable tool for quickly boosting the total rolls and Rolling stat.

Rare Potion Chest.description: The Rare Potion Chest is obtainable by buying any of the four Update Package Gamepasses. The quantity in which you receive this chest depends on which Package you buy. The Alpha Update Package will give you 5, the Beta Update Package will give you 10, the Gamma Update Package will give you 25, and the Delta Update Package will give you 60. Mega Potion Chest.name: Mega Potion Chest
Mega Potion Chest.description: The Mega Potion Chest is obtainable by buying either the Beta, Gamma or Delta Package Gamepass. This makes it the hardest Potion Chest to obtain, but that also means that it's rewards are better than the Rare Potion Chest. Buying the Beta Update Package will give you 3, the Gamma Update Package gives you 10, and the Delta Update Package will give you 40. The chances for high rarity potions increase while the low rarity potions have their chances decrease further. The most common potions you will get from this Potion Chest are the Fortune Potion II and Haste Potion II.

Normal Item Ticket.name: Normal Item Ticket
Normal Item Ticket.how_to_get: The Normal Item Ticket used to be obtained via three methods:; By Rolling, with a 1 in 10,000 (0.01%) chance to pull it.; Dropped by Santa; Purchased from the Winter Package Vol.1, Vol.2 and Vol.3, each granting 10, 20 and 50 Normal Item Tickets respectively.

Rare Item Ticket.name: Rare Item Ticket
Rare Item Ticket.how_to_get: Similarly like its common and rarer counterpart, the Rare Item Ticket used to be obtained with the three following methods:; By Rolling, with a 1 in 100,000 (0.001%) to pull one.; As an uncommon drop from Santa.; By purchasing Winter Packages, granting 5, 10 and 25 per volume respectively.

Mega Item Ticket.name: Mega Item Ticket
Mega Item Ticket.how_to_get: The Mega Item Ticket used to be obtained through the following ways:; Via Rolling, with an insane 1 in 1,000,000 (0.0001%) chance to be rolled.; Very rarely dropped by Santa.; Purchased from the Winter Packages, with each volume granting 1, 2 and 5.

Easter Eggs.description: An egg containing the power of a Biome.

Lucky Clover.name: Lucky Clover
Lucky Clover.description: The Lucky Clover is an Item that was added in Eon 1. Upon walking over a clover, you will be granted the Clover Effect for 4 minutes, which grants +40% Luck. This Item cannot be stored in the Inventory, so henceforth cannot be bought or sold. This Item can spawn randomly throughout the world near the player, but cannot spawn in caves or on water.; Clovers will spawn every 1-3 minutes, and will despawn after a few minutes of not being picked up. There can be up to 3 clovers per player spawned at a time.

Void Heart.name: Void Heart
Void Heart.how_to_get: After completing Dave's fourth quest "A timeless land", he will reward the player with the Void Heart Recipe, among other things. The Void Heart Recipe is an item in the inventory that falls under the "Tool" tab, and it must be used to unlock the recipe. After that, you can craft the Void Heart from Stella's Cauldron in the cave.
Void Heart.description: Gives you [Shattered Heart]: +300,000 Luck for Next 1 Roll

Winter Medal 2025.name: Winter Medal 2025
Winter Medal 2025.how_to_get: Obtained from completing all of Lime's winter quests
Winter Medal 2025.description: The Winter Medal 2025 is an item added during the Winter Event. Upon completing Lime's fourth Christmas Quest, players will be awarded the Winter Medal 2025 which can then be subsequently exchanged for the Blossom: Frozen And Frigid aura.

Wish Stars.name: Wish Stars
Wish Stars.how_to_get: The Wish Stars can be obtained by using the Meteoric Egg. Upon using the egg, you will be given 5 Wish Stars along with the Starfall Egg. Wish Stars can also be obtainable through the Season IV Pass at level 33 on both the Premium and Regular passes, and level 50 on the Premium pass.
Wish Stars.description: [Easter 2025] [Christmas 2025] Gives 5 stack of [Wishing Star]: +50,000 Luck for 1 roll.

Wish Stocking.name: Wish Stocking
Wish Stocking.how_to_get: Wish Stockings have a chance to appear in the Memory Match and a 0.5% (1 in 200) chance to be obtained from the Roulette. After obtaining the Wish Stocking, it will appear in the Christmas section of your inventory.
Wish Stocking.description: [Christmas 2025] When used in the Snowy or Aurora biome, Someone who has heard your wish will come to you bearing a gift.
